# U03 recorded synthetic host exchange

`host-exchange/` contains the actual accepted exchange from installed Codex CLI
0.161.0, requested gpt-6.1-sol/high, in a fresh isolated test run. Sources and
system IDs are synthetic. No real law, company fact, approval, production
artifact or completed compliance package is represented here.

The two G1 snapshots bind synthetic source bytes and provenance; their historical
fixture attempt times remain explicit. This is a test replay, not fresh live
source acquisition. Packet creation/response and host execution have actual
U03 times. The helper constructed the response envelope and validated the
agent-authored proposal; the supervisor independently reread all bindings.

Instruction/reference bytes and their hashes are retained. Host events, prompt,
requested model/effort, visible usage and independent outcome are included.
Unreported provider model/effort remain null; private reasoning is not retained.
The recording is immutable test evidence. New live tests create new run IDs and
interpretations without consuming this recorded response. Deterministic tests
may replay it explicitly through the frozen contract validator.
